characters.description: En misunnelig og hard dronning som plager Kari og legger planer for å bli kvitt den blå oksen.
characters.look: A tall, thin queen of about forty with a long, pinched face, a sharp pointed nose, narrow pale-green eyes, thin arched eyebrows, a small mouth turned down at the corners and jet-black hair scraped into a tight bun under a tall, spiky silver crown. characters.name: Datteren til dronningen
characters.description: Dronningens datter, like stygg og slem som kongedatteren er snill og vakker. Hun får gullskoen på og blir pyntet til brud.
characters.look: A gangly young woman of about eighteen with a long, sour face, a pinched, turned-up nose, small squinting pale-green eyes, a pouting mouth and thin, straw-pale hair in two stiff braids that stick out sideways. She wears an over-trimmed dress of sour gooseberry-green wool covered in far too many pink ribbons, white stockings and pointed green shoes on very long, big feet.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: En stolt prins som først avviser Kari i trestakken, men blir dypt betatt av den ukjente jenta i de skinnende kjolene og leter etter henne med gullskoen.
characters.look: A broad-shouldered prince of about twenty-two with a proud, stubborn face, a strong jaw, a slightly hooked nose, bright blue eyes under straight fair brows and thick, wavy honey-blond hair swept back from his forehead and falling to his collar, under a small gold crown. He wears a heather-purple wool tunic with gold trim over a cream linen shirt, a short dark-green cloak fastened with a round gold brooch, black hose and soft black leather boots.

characters.name: Mannen i berget
characters.description: En mann som kommer ut av bergveggen når Kari banker på med kjeppen, og som gir henne kjoler av kobber, sølv og gull og en hest å ri til kirken.
characters.look: A small, sturdy old man no taller than a young girl, with a round, rosy, wrinkled face, a big round nose, twinkling bright-blue eyes under bushy white eyebrows and a long, silky white beard that reaches his knees. He wears a long, hooded moss-green cloak with a wooden toggle, a brown tunic with a rope belt and soft brown boots, and carries a small brass lantern that glows warm yellow.

characters.name: Trollet med tre hoder
characters.description: Trollet som eier kobberskogen, og som kommer farende med alle tre hodene når kongedatteren river av et blad.
characters.look: A squat, pot-bellied troll about twice as tall as a man, with pale, chalky grey-white skin like weathered limestone, speckled with grey freckles and patches of moss, short bandy legs and long dangling arms. It has three bald, egg-shaped heads on three thick necks, each with a big red bulbous nose, small round orange eyes, one crooked tooth and tufts of stiff orange hair behind the ears. It wears a ragged brown sacking kilt, with a curved cow horn of ointment hanging from its rope belt.

characters.name: Trollet med seks hoder
characters.description: Trollet som eier sølvskogen. Det er dobbelt så sterkt som det første, og det slåss med oksen i tre hele døgn.
characters.look: A tall, lanky troll about three times as tall as a man, with knobbly, rusty-orange skin like iron-stained rock, patched with grey lichen, long skinny arms and legs and huge flat feet. On a wide, bony pair of shoulders sit six small heads in a row, each with a long droopy nose, sleepy yellow eyes, big flappy ears and wispy white hair like bog cotton. It wears a moth-eaten grey wool tunic, with a curved cow horn of ointment on a string at its belt.

characters.name: Trollet med ni hoder
characters.description: Trollet som eier gullskogen, større og sterkere enn de to andre trollene til sammen. For hvert hode oksen stanger i hjel, blåser de andre liv i det igjen.
characters.look: An enormous, pear-shaped troll as tall as six men, with lumpy skin the dusky pink and purple of blooming heather, a huge round belly and short, stumpy arms and legs like tree stumps. Along its broad shoulders sit nine small round heads in a row, each with puffy cheeks, a tiny snub nose, small black eyes under bushy grey brows, big round ears and a shock of spiky grey hair. It wears a huge patched brown hide tunic, with a curved cow horn of ointment hanging from its belt.

places.name: the Church Hill
places.look: A small, dark, tarred stave church with steep, tiered shingle roofs, carved dragon heads on the gables and a tall arched door inside a low, covered wooden porch, standing on top of a green hill below the castle. A low stone wall surrounds the churchyard, a few birches with yellowing leaves stand around it, and a gravel path with a few stone steps leads up to the porch past a wooden hitching rail for horses.
